```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r, include=FALSE}
pacman::p_load(
  "tidyverse", # for data wrangling
  "mirt", # for conducting the main GRM analysis
  "skimr"
)
```


```{r}
data <- read_csv("./data.csv")
data
```


## model


```{r}
fit <- mirt(data=data, itemtype="graded", SE=T, verbose=F)
fit
```

```{r}
coefs <- as.data.frame(coef(fit, simplify=T, IRTpars=T)$items)
b_cols <- grep("^b", colnames(coefs), value=TRUE)
b_mat  <- as.matrix(coefs[, b_cols])

mirt_params <- data.frame(item=rownames(coefs), a=coefs$a, b_mat)

dir.create("./results", showWarnings=FALSE)
write_csv(mirt_params, "./results/mirt_params.csv")
mirt_params
```

```{r}
theta_mat <- fscores(fit, method="EAP")
theta_df  <- data.frame(person=seq_len(nrow(theta_mat)), theta=theta_mat[, "F1"])
write_csv(theta_df, "./results/mirt_theta.csv")
theta_df
```
